title: Quick Gooey Vietnamese Ham Pho
description: A rich and savory Vietnamese dish made with serrano ham and dashi extract, ready in under an hour.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the dashi extract and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Add the serrano ham and cook for 2 minutes, or until heated through.
Add the green onions, bean sprouts, fried shallots, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions and fried shallots if desired.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions before using.
You can adjust the amount of dashi extract and fish sauce to taste.
This recipe is best served immediately, but it can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours and reheated.
